map.title: The Story Path
map.comingSoonHint: This story is being prepared and will arrive in a future update.
map.ntLocked: Opens after the Old Testament journey.
map.confirmNew: Starting a new game will erase your progress in “{chapter}”. This cannot be undone.

eden.title: The Garden of Eden
eden.summary: Adam and Eve in the garden God planted, the command about the tree, the serpent, and the way out of Eden.

cain-abel.title: Cain and Abel
cain-abel.summary: The first brothers, their offerings, and the question “Where is your brother?”

noah.title: Noah and the Flood
noah.summary: Noah builds the ark, and God sets the rainbow as a sign of His promise.

babel.title: The Tower of Babel
babel.summary: People build a tower to make a name for themselves, and God scatters the languages.

abraham.title: The Call of Abraham
abraham.summary: God calls Abram to a new land and promises him descendants as many as the stars.

lot.title: Lot and Sodom
lot.summary: Angels lead Lot and his family out of Sodom before the city is destroyed.

isaac.title: Isaac and Rebekah
isaac.summary: At the well, Abraham's servant meets Rebekah, who becomes Isaac's wife.

jacob.title: Jacob
jacob.summary: Jacob dreams of a ladder reaching to heaven, and God keeps His promise to him.

joseph.title: Joseph and His Brothers
joseph.summary: From the pit to the palace: Joseph forgives his brothers.

nativity.title: The Birth of Jesus
nativity.summary: Shepherds hear the good news in the fields near Bethlehem.

baptism.title: The Baptism of Jesus
baptism.summary: Jesus is baptised by John in the Jordan.

disciples.title: The Calling of the Disciples
disciples.summary: “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.”

sermon.title: The Sermon on the Mount
sermon.summary: Jesus teaches the crowds on the mountainside.

five-thousand.title: Feeding the Five Thousand
five-thousand.summary: Five loaves and two fish feed a great crowd.

prodigal.title: The Prodigal Son
prodigal.summary: A father runs to welcome his son home.

fun.title: Fun
fun.intro: Light activities to enjoy between stories.
fun.namingDesc: Unscramble the names of the animals of Eden.
fun.namingLocked: Unlocks after the “Naming the Animals” mission.
fun.triviaDesc: Short quizzes about the stories you have played.
fun.versesDesc: Learn a verse from each story.

more.title: More Games
more.intro: Other games from the Bible Games Project.
more.empty: More Bible Games Project titles will appear here soon.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reduceMotionHint: Fewer screen flashes, light pulses and camera moves.

pause.title: Paused
pause.restartConfirm: Restart the current mission from its beginning?
pause.saveNote: Your progress is saved at the end of every mission.

pregame.headphones: For the best experience, use headphones.
pregame.touchAct: Tap the button to pick up, use or talk

puzzle.title: Name the Animal
puzzle.instructions: Put the letters in order to give this animal its name.
puzzle.typeHint: You can also type the letters.

stealth.seen: You stepped into the open. Fear and shame send you back to hide.

complete.title: Chapter Complete
complete.body: Adam and Eve left the garden. Cherubim guard the way to the tree of life. The story continues.
complete.next: Next on the path: Cain and Abel — coming soon.
